sn54.9:1.2: ekaṃ samayam Bhagavā Vesāliyaṃ viharati Mahāvane Kuṭāgārasālāyaṃ || || 2.
sn54.9:1.3: Tena kho pana samayena Bhagavā bhikkhūnam anekapariyāyena asubhakathaṃ katheti || asubhāya vaṇṇam bhāsati asubhabhāvanāya vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati || || 3.
sn54.9:2.3: namhi kenaci upasaṅkamitabbo aññatra ekena piṇḍapātanīhārakena ti || ||
sn54.9:2.4: Evam bhante ti kho te bhikkhū Bhagavato paṭissutvā nāssudha koci Bhagavantam upasaṅkamati aññatra ekena piṇḍapātanīhārakena || || 4.
sn54.9:3.2: Bhagavā anekapariyāyena asubhakatham kathesi asubhāya vaṇṇam bhāsati || asubhabhāvanāya vaṇṇam bhāsatī ti || anekākāravokāram asubhabhāvanānuyogam anuyuttā viharanti || ||
sn54.9:3.3: Te iminā kāyena aṭṭiyāmānā harāyamānā jigucchamānā satthahārakam pariyesanti ||
sn54.9:3.4: dasa pi bhikkhū ekāhena sattham āharanti || vīsam pi || la || tiṃsam pi ekāhena sattham āharanti || || 5.
sn54.9:4.1: Atha kho Bhagavā tassa uḍḍhamāsassa accayena paṭisallaṇā vuṭṭhito āyasmantam Ānandam āmantesi || ||
sn54.9:4.2: Kiṃ nu kho Ānanda tanubhūto viya bhikkhusaṅgho ti || || 6.
sn54.9:4.3: Tathā hi pana bhante Bhagavā bhikkhūnam anekapariyāyena asubhakatham kathesi asubhāya vaṇṇam bhāsati asubhabhāvanāya vaṇṇam bhāsati || [te ca bhante bhikkhū Bhagavā kho anekapariyāyena asubhakathaṃ kathesi || asubhāya vaṇṇambhāsati asubhabhāvanāya vaṇṇam bhāsatī ti] anekākāravokāram asubhabhāvanānuyogam anuyuttā viharanti || ||
sn54.9:4.4: Te iminā kāyena aṭṭiyamānā harāyamānā satthahārakam pariyesanti
sn54.9:4.5: dasa pi bhikkhū vīsampi- tiṃsam pi bhikkhū ekāhena sattham āharanti || ||
sn54.9:4.6: Sādhu bhante Bhagavā aññam pariyāyam ācikkhatu tathā yathāyam bhikkhusaṅgho aññāya saṇṭhaheyyā ti || || 7.
sn54.9:5.1: Tenhānanda yāvatikā bhikkhū Vesālim upanissāya viharanti || te sabbe upaṭṭhānasālāyaṃ sannipātehī ti || ||
sn54.9:5.2: Evam bhante ti kho āyasmā Ānando Bhagavato paṭissutvā yāvatikā bhikkhū Vesālim upanissāya viharanti || te sabbe upaṭṭhānasālāyam sannipātetvā yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bagavantam etad avoca ||
sn54.9:5.4: yassa dāni Bhagavā kālam maññatī ti || || 8.
sn54.9:6.1: Atha kho Bhagavā yena upaṭṭhānasālā tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi ||
sn54.9:6.3: Ayam pi kho bhikkhave ānāpānasatisamādhi bhāvito bahulīkato santo ceva paṇīto ca asecanako sukho ca vihāro uppannuppanne ca pāpake akusale dhamme ṭhānaso antaradhāpeti vūpasameti || || 10.
sn54.9:7.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave gimhānam pacchime māse ūhataṃ rajojallaṃ tam enam mahā akālamegho ṭhānaso antaradhāpeti vūpasamati ||
sn54.9:7.2: Evam eva kho bhikkhave ānāpānasati samādhi bhāvito bahulīkato santo ceva paṇīto ca asecanako ca sukho ca viharo uppannuppanne pāpake akusale dhamme ṭhānaso antaradhāpeti vūpasameti || || 11.
sn54.9:7.3: Katham bhāvito ca bhikkhave ānāpānasatisamādhi katham bahulīkato santo ceva paṇīto ca asecanako ca sukho ca vihāro uppannuppanne ca pāpake akusale dhamme ṭhānaso antaradhāpeti vūpasameti || || 12--18.
sn54.9:8.1: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu araññagato vā rukkhamūlagato vā suññāgāragato vā ||
sn54.9:8.4: Evam bhāvito kho bhikkhave ānāpānasatisamādhi evam bahulīkato santo ceva paṇīto ca asecanako sukho ca vihāro uppannuppanne ca pāpake akusale dhamme ṭhānaso antaradhāpeti vūpasametī
